method: Reversible original stream hashes, subprocess status/timestamps/argv, result parsing, explicit package mappings and compile/run linkage independently checked without importing project runner code.
limitations: Subprocess records establish the command/result chain, not SDK or executable byte identity; those binaries were not hashed.
Package configuration and project source hashes are recorded; installed dependency source bytes are not.
The review does not infer allocated bytes, GC attribution, significance or a performance guarantee.
